text: True or False: Under the Curry–Howard correspondence for dependent types, the dependent sum type Σx:A. B(x) corresponds to the universal quantifier ∀x:A. B(x).
explanation: False — the correspondence is swapped. The dependent product (Π-type) Πx:A. B(x) corresponds to the universal quantifier ∀; the dependent sum (Σ-type) corresponds to the existential quantifier ∃ — a witness a : A paired with evidence of B(a).
